title: MEGA: Multilingual Evaluation of Generative AI
reasoning: The paper includes a 'Responsible AI (RAI)' section that evaluates models on 'Toxicity Prediction' and 'Gender Bias'. While these are important ethical considerations in AI, the evaluation is specific to these defined types of harm (toxic comments, gender bias in MT systems) and does not broadly benchmark or evaluate LLMs on a wider range of morals, ethics, or faith-related reasoning as a core component.
